# Design: Phase 4 — Variables

<!-- generated by @feature-intake on 2026-08-07 -->

## Problem & Intent

Editor und Templates kennen keine Brevo-Merge-Tags. Mitarbeiter sollen über einen **Variable-Picker** Labels wählen und `{{ params.<key> }}` in Text/Button einfügen. Preview zeigt **Sample Data** aus einer API, nicht Live-ERP. Erfolg: eine Variable Registry (Customer / Order / Invoice), Picker-UI, Sample-Preview — kompatibel zum HVAI-Send-Pfad (`EmailParams` + Mahnung-Params).

## Non-Goals

- ERP-Blöcke (Auftrag-CTA, Kundeninfo als GrapesJS-Typen) — User: **nur Picker**
- Brevo Render Preview API / Publish / Sync / Legacy Importer
- Live-Daten aus HVAI-DB oder JWT→ERP-Fetch in Phase 4
- Variable-Admin-CRUD (Keys editieren im UI)
- Contact-Attribute außerhalb `params.*` (`contact.FIRSTNAME` etc.)
- Drop-in / iframe Host-Contract (später)
- Authz-Gates jenseits bestehendem DevAuth

## Assumptions (Socratic 2026-08-07)

1. **Syntax:** ausschließlich `{{ params.<key> }}` (Brevo transactional `params`)
2. **UI:** nur Variable-Picker (kein Block-Kategorie „ERP“)
3. **Sample:** schon API (`GET` Sample + Catalog)
4. **Katalog:** volle Customer/Order/Invoice-Liste wie ERP-Send — Snapshot aus HVAI `EmailParams` + Mahnung-Felder (nicht Live-Sync)

## Research

### Was im Repo schon da ist

- `packages/email-components` — Text/Button mit Traits; Sanitize F-02
- `apps/api` — Fastify Templates + DevAuth; `{ data, error }`
- Styleguide: Variable picker; Bottom „Preview Data“
- PRD §D Variablen & Preview
- AGENTS: Variable Registry **einmal** in `packages/`

### ERP-Quelle (HVAI-123, read-only)

- `core/.../order_detail/services/email.service.ts` → `EmailParams`
- `useMahnungTemplate.ts` → zusätzliche Invoice/Mahnung-Keys + Regex `\{\{\s*params\.(\w+)\s*\}\}`

Sample values: realistische DE-Musterdaten (gleiche Keys), **nicht** echte Kundendaten.

### Decision matrix (@search-first)

| Option | Verdict |
|--------|---------|
| Adopt GrapesJS plugin for merge tags | Reject — control + DE labels + ERP catalog |
| Extend email-components only | Partial — picker is editor chrome, registry is shared |
| New `packages/email-variables` | **Adopt** — AGENTS „Registry einmal“; API + Editor import same package |
| Hardcode picker list only in React | Reject — duplicates API/sample |

## Options Considered

### Option A: Package registry + API catalog/sample + Picker + Preview (recommended)

- Shared `packages/email-variables` (defs, expression helper, sample map)
- API: `GET /api/variables`, `GET /api/preview/sample` (auth via DevAuth)
- Editor: Picker panel + insert at selection; Preview toggle substitutes sample
- Pros: Single SoT; ERP-aligned keys; testable; Publish later uses same expressions
- Cons: Catalog is snapshot — drift until later sync job
- Evidence: User answers; HVAI EmailParams; PRD §D

### Option B: API proxies live ERP variable schema

- Pros: Always fresh
- Cons: Needs ERP auth/network; Push-Verbot / no HVAI changes; out of Phase 4
- Reject for Phase 4

### Option C: YAGNI — only document keys in README

- Pros: Zero code
- Cons: No picker/preview; blocks Publish usability
- Rejected per user „phase 4 /implement“ path

## Decision

**Chosen:** Option A  
**Why:** Matches Socratic answers; mirrors ERP send params; keeps registry in one package; API for sample as requested; picker-only UI.

## Cross-Domain Sign-Off

| Domain | Status | Note |
|--------|--------|------|
| KISS | ✅ | One package + 2 GETs + picker |
| SOLID | ✅ | Registry vs substitute vs UI getrennt |
| DRY | ✅ | Expression + catalog shared FE/BE |
| Security | ⚠️ | Sample = public-ish under DevAuth; no PII in seeds; insert only known keys; sanitize still for HTML |
| UI/UX | ✅ | DE Labels; Styleguide picker |
| Scaling | ✅ | Static catalog; API cheap |
| Testability | ✅ | Unit registry/substitute; API; E2E insert+preview |
| Maintainability | ✅ | Catalog comment: source = HVAI EmailParams path |

**Ponytail rung:** ~4 (new thin package + reuse Fastify routes). Rung 1 skip rejected.

## Confidence

**85%** — ERP keys from EmailParams+Mahnung confirmed; ⚠️ possible additional undocumented template params in Brevo HTML not in TS interface (document as follow-up: scrape templates later)

## Implementation Sketch

```
packages/email-variables/          (new)
  src/registry.ts                  # VariableDef[] groups customer|order|invoice|meta
  src/expression.ts                # toExpression(key) → {{ params.key }}; parse/validate
  src/sample.ts                    # SampleData map
  src/substitute.ts                # replace {{ params.x }} with sample values
  src/index.ts

apps/api/src/variables/routes.ts   # GET /api/variables, GET /api/preview/sample
apps/api/src/index.ts              # register routes

apps/editor/src/variables/         # VariablePicker + useVariablesApi
apps/editor/src/templates/TemplateEditorPage.tsx  # mount picker; preview mode

apps/editor/e2e/phase-4-variables.spec.ts
.qa/acceptance/phase-4-variables.md   # via @implement
```

Not in Phase 4: brevo-adapter, ERP blocks, live ERP fetch, contact.* tags

## Runtime Matrix

| Slice area | Local | Cloud/ERP live |
|------------|-------|----------------|
| Registry package | yes | n/a (static) |
| API catalog/sample | yes (DevAuth) | later JWT — same routes |
| Picker + Preview | yes (Vite editor) | same |

## UI Direction

Minimal editor chrome: rechts/unten **„Variablen“**-Liste gruppiert (Kunde / Auftrag / Rechnung), Klick fügt Expression ein. Preview-Toggle **„Beispieldaten“** ersetzt Tags im Preview-iframe — keine neue Aesthetic, Theme-Contract Tokens.
